name: USAS Building System (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: USAS Building System (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., incorporated in 1999 and based in Songjiang, provides prefabricated steel structure building subcontracting and general contracting services in China, Southeast Asia, the United States and elsewhere. It also supplies industrial environmental equipment such as filtration and noise reduction systems for gas turbines. Its customers span automotive, machinery, food, textile and pharmaceutical sectors. It is a subsidiary of Broad Vision International Group Limited.
